commentary: Revenue for August came in at [[revenue.month.actual]], above budget by [[revenue.month.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.month.vs_py]] ([[revenue.month.vs_py_pct]]), while direct costs of [[direct_costs.month.actual]] ran above budget by [[direct_costs.month.vs_budget]] ([[direct_costs.month.vs_budget_pct]]), leaving gross profit for August at [[gross_profit.month.actual]], below budget by [[gross_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[gross_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and gross margin at [[gross_margin.month.actual]], below budget by [[gross_margin.month.vs_budget_pp]]. Operating profit for August was [[operating_profit.month.actual]], below budget by [[operating_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and below last year by [[operating_profit.month.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_py_pct]]). Year to date, revenue stands at [[revenue.ytd.actual]], above budget by [[revenue.ytd.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.ytd.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.ytd.vs_py]] ([[revenue.ytd.vs_py_pct]]), with operating profit year to date of [[operating_profit.ytd.actual]] above budget by [[operating_profit.ytd.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.ytd.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[operating_profit.ytd.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.ytd.vs_py_pct]]). On clients, Orchard Lane Foods contributed [[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.actual]] in August, [[client.orchard-lane.share.month.actual]] of agency revenue and above its May to July average by [[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]), while Marlow & Finch fell to [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.actual]] in August, below its May to July average by [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]) and down to [[client.marlow-finch.share.month.actual]] of agency revenue against [[client.marlow-finch.share.ytd.actual]] year to date.
